applies_to: Only the new origin-transition v1 signed-object and evidence-verification path in Manage and Nest; not ordinary legacy release/provisioning input validators.
reason: The legacy Python ipaddress formatter has version-dependent IPv4-mapped IPv6 output, and its scoped-address support does not match Rust Ipv6Addr. Freeze a conservative common subset rather than silently changing signed strings, selecting semantics by interpreter version, or modifying ordinary installed-device validation.
relationship_to_contract: Explicit narrowing addendum to the Origin primitive in origin-transition-contract-v1.json. Preserve that original document and the existing shared signature fixture byte-for-byte. New transition consumers must enforce this profile in addition to their existing release and signature checks.
rules: Origin remains an ASCII string of at most 2048 bytes, canonical lowercase https://host[:port], with no userinfo, path, slash suffix, query, fragment, whitespace or control characters.

Retain the existing release validator DNS-label and IPv4 rules without widening or additional URL-parser normalization. Explicit port 443, zero, noncanonical leading-zero ports and ports above 65535 are rejected.
Unscoped, non-IPv4-mapped IPv6 literals remain allowed in brackets with deterministic RFC5952 lowercase compressed spelling. Do not normalize the supplied signed text before accepting it.
Reject scoped IPv6 literals, including raw percent scope identifiers and percent-encoded zone identifiers, in this new transition profile.

Reject IPv4-mapped IPv6 literals in every spelling, including dotted and hexadecimal tails, in this new transition profile. These can receive a separately reviewed future profile if needed; do not pick Python-version-specific acceptance.
Both source and target origins and their release/evidence crosslinks use the identical profile. Exact environment-specific origin binding remains mandatory; this grammar is not a transport allowlist.

Ordinary legacy release parsing and existing deployed same-origin updates remain unchanged. Legacy releases outside this new profile are not eligible for this transition protocol; never relabel their signed bytes. Known cybex.net to tiaris.com migration DNS origins are inside the profile.
